rationale: Weights for SubsystemScoreCalculator's degradation/risk/persistence/recurrence blend. These are the same values the code shipped with before this file existed -- moving them here does not change scoring output, it only makes them reviewable and revisable without recompiling. They are round numbers chosen for a plausible relative emphasis (event risk dominant, degradation score next, persistence/recurrence as smaller modifiers) and are NOT fitted against real fleet outcome data. Revisit once GoMechanic domain review or real failure/repair outcomes are available.
